class: A browser view that renders numbers from the last answer it holds keeps showing that answer's numbers after ITS OWN live connection drops, until a later answer replaces it: when the fallback read is slow, hangs, fails, or an older read resolves after the drop, an old number stays on screen looking live. Wider shape: liveness must be a property of the moment the number is shown (the view's own connection now), never of the answer object that happened to arrive last.
mechanism: 2026-10-19, GC-5S: (1) W-113 LiveStrategyCard.vue: paused was false while the socket status was 'connecting' after a drop, so the last COMPUTED push showed as live until the REST fallback answered; (2) W-114 IndexViewPage.vue: onDown set failed=true but kept answer = the last LIVE push and shownValue checked only answer.state, so after a drop with a failing fallback both panels kept the old value with its 'as of' time; a first-paint read sent before a drop could resolve later and restore LIVE; (3) W-115 IndexStrip.vue copied the page's logic before the W-114 fix and repeated it.

first_seen.where: GC-5S W-113 Tier B verifier (4f82043), W-114 Tier A verifier (dbc4d84), W-115 Tier B verifier (a219c3b)
first_seen.evidence: Proven by red tests: W-113 aaf1af8 mutation (wasLive clause reverted) -> 1 failed (the reconnect test); W-114 7740aa8 mutations: clear-on-drop removed -> the Proof test red, drop counter removed -> the first-paint race test red. W-115 found by code reading (IndexStrip.vue onDown has no clear-on-drop and no drop counter); fixed structurally in round 2.

fix: Structural (run-discipline B8): one state machine in frontend/src/composables/useIndexLive.js (first-paint read, drop counter, clear-on-drop, fallback read, shown values only from a LIVE answer received after the latest drop), rendered by both the index page and the Home strip (W-115 round 2). The Live Strategies card keeps its own wasLive gate (W-113 aaf1af8).

detection.note: Per-component tests exist (frontend/tests/live-strategies.test.js reconnect test; index-view.test.js drop tests; W-115 round 2 table test over page and strip). No repo-wide check forces every new live view through a shared liveness state; a new live screen (Option Chain, item 4b) can repeat the class. Next mechanism: the chain screen uses the same composable pattern, and a frontend test enumerates every component that opens a live socket and runs the drop table against it.
